name: Marriott Executive Apartments, Penang
short_description: Long-stay serviced apartments on Gurney Drive with one- and two-bedroom suites featuring full kitchens and in-apartment laundry, sharing facilities with the adjacent Penang Marriott Hotel.
ai_summary: Marriott Executive Apartments, Penang is a Marriott Executive Apartments (MEA) property built for extended and family stays on the seafront Gurney Drive promenade in George Town. Its roughly 90 one- and two-bedroom suites come with fully equipped kitchens (full-size fridge, cooktop, dishwasher and cooking utensils), in-apartment washer/dryer, and separate living and dining areas, giving it a residential 'home away from home' feel that recurs across independent reviews. It forms part of the Penang Marriott Complex and shares dining and leisure facilities with the adjacent Penang Marriott Hotel, including an outdoor/infinity pool, a well-equipped seafront gym, a kids' club, and restaurants such as Sago (Malaysian/Indian), Kucina (Italian) and Lava Java cafe. On TripAdvisor it holds about 4.0/5 from a small review base (roughly 20 reviews, ranked around #75 of 194 George Town hotels), so ratings are still thin; independent family blogs are consistently very positive, praising the spacious clean apartments, extensive breakfast buffet and attentive service. Guests especially value the location (walkable to Gurney Bay park, Gurney Plaza mall, and about a 10-minute drive to the UNESCO heritage core). A recurring minor gripe is unclear communication of facility booking rules (e.g. steam room advance booking).

faqs.question: Do the apartments have full kitchens and laundry?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each one- and two-bedroom suite has a fully equipped kitchen (full-size fridge, cooktop, dishwasher and cooking utensils) plus an in-apartment washer and dryer, making it well suited to families and extended stays.

faqs.question: Can guests use the Penang Marriott Hotel facilities?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Executive Apartments sit within the same Penang Marriott Complex, so guests share the swimming pools, fitness centre, kids' club and restaurants with the adjacent Penang Marriott Hotel.

faqs.question: How far is it from Penang International Airport?
faqs.answer: The property is on Gurney Drive in George Town, roughly 17 km (about a 25-30 minute drive) from Penang International Airport (PEN).
